summary: Diff appears to remove frontend admin routes/navigation and updates the Upload page copy to immediate publish, and backend no longer shows an articleSubmissions store (plus adds a migration module to drop it). However, key backend API changes for immediate publish + authenticated upload and full removal of moderation/admin canister methods are not evidenced in the truncated backend diff, and the React Query upload invalidation behavior is also not directly evidenced due to truncation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove the submission moderation workflow from the Motoko backend (no Pending/Approved/Rejected, no ArticleSubmission moderation store/queue, and no moderation canister methods such as approve/reject/getPending).
missing_requirements.reason: While backend/migration.mo and backend/main.mo show removal of the articleSubmissions map at the storage level, the backend diff is truncated before any upload/moderation-related canister methods would appear. There is no explicit evidence in the provided diff summary that moderation-related methods (approveSubmission/rejectSubmission/approveOrRejectSubmission/getPendingArticles) were removed, or that SubmissionStatus is no longer defined/used everywhere.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the backend upload API to publish immediately into Articles while rejecting anonymous callers (Internet Identity required), and ensure the published Article includes required fields.
missing_requirements.reason: Upload/publish canister method implementation is not shown in the truncated backend/main.mo diff, so there is no direct evidence that the upload API now writes to the articles store, rejects anonymous callers, and returns/persists the required Article fields.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update React Query hooks to align upload mutation with immediate publish and invalidate/refetch article list queries (at minimum queryKey ['articles']).
missing_requirements.reason: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts is truncated exactly around useUploadArticle(), so the diff summary does not show the onSuccess invalidation/refetch logic for ['articles'] (or other relevant keys).

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced explicit backend state migration module to drop the old articleSubmissions map.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requirements focus on removing moderation workflow and updating APIs/UI; it does not request adding a standalone migration module/file.
evidence: backend/main.mo (import Migration "migration"; and actor migration setup)
